scope: Investigation uses the supplied checkpoint and synthetic mixed-function fixtures; no original puzzle or generator proof is used. The proposed cut/SAT improvements are experimental, not enabled production strategies in this change.

raised_allowance_profile.note: Measured in a separate isolated profile; raising the cap alone did not produce an emitted circuit.

abstract_rainbow.limitation: A logical cut rewrite, not yet a physical circuit rewrite: leaf values need to be live or reversibly materialized.

dependency_region.finding: Existing dependencySort can already find the noncontiguous region globally; broadSearch only supplies contiguous windows and local search is chunk-bounded.

sat_mixed_circuit.finding: The whole-circuit sweep proves an identity but cannot emit the remaining cubic map. A regional patch preserves that map and removes the independent identity.

implementation_findings.abstract_rainbow: Existing tables index complete reversible wire transformations, not scalar Boolean functions. An adapter must include accumulator/boundary state, preserve live outputs, and lower abstract leaves to actual wire values. Universal cut truth tables remain valid even if leaves are correlated.
implementation_findings.sat_sweeping: Current code builds a global formula, groups candidates once, counts SAT counterexamples without resimulating them, and applies aliases without a repeated rebuild/sweep. The emitter only handles affine or supported quadratic maps, so valid internal merges can yield no saved progress on mixed maps.
implementation_findings.dependency_regions: Local findConvexSubsets already uses dependency selection, but worker chunks and local gate-count limits bound it. Broad search is contiguous. A global, version-aware convex region interface can route safely extractable regions through existing strategies.

recommended_order: Global dependency regions with preserved boundary versions and safe circuit patching.
Abstract-expression cut truth tables and rainbow adapters, using register/liveness-aware lowering.
Cone-local SAT proofs, retain proved identities, refine simulation from counterexamples, rebuild and sweep again, and emit local circuit patches.
Measure a compact XOR representation or live-graph compaction before increasing global graph allowances.

integration_coverage: Refill locals while broad search is active.
Run broad searches repeatedly during long rounds with queue priority.
Retarget empty chunk lanes and select the best alternative without concatenating retries.
Stop refilling on cancellation, improvement restart, or round completion.
